title: Listening Drill — Recycling centre tour
description: Visitor briefing. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Recycling centre tour
sections.transcript:
GUIDE: Welcome to our visit to the recycling centre. Before we leave, make sure your name appears on the list I'm holding. If you can't see your name, speak to me privately rather than adding it yourself.

GUIDE: Our meeting point is the security cabin. The visit itself will last sixty minutes. You don't need to take anything heavy, but please bring a photo ID.

GUIDE: We'll finish at the staff entrance. From there you can make your own way home. One last detail: stay inside the painted walkway. If you're separated from the group, phone the number printed on your ticket rather than taking a shortcut.
